payload.description: Compare open-source task-retrieval and relationship models against the preserved Laya pilot. Expanded at user's request: train/distill a specialized non-generative dense or static relation encoder with target budgets near 10M and 100M total parameters, and tokenizer-vocabulary ablations including 100k/200k tokens where feasible. Use user request Q and assistant response/plan A as separate evidence channels: test Q only, A only, Q+A concatenation and a predeclared fusion. Benchmark retrieval across large Markdown and structured DIP stores, not only classification of one supplied pair. Research shortlist includes Model2Vec/Potion (7.6M/32.3M English and128.1M multilingual), multilingual E5-small and MiniLM-L12 (~117.7M, Hebrew listed), small English BGE/MiniLM controls, and larger GTE/Qwen/BGE reranker references. No alternative has yet been run or proven superior. Licensed source/weight review and independent held-out evaluation required.
acceptance: Verify code and weight licenses, pinned revisions, local CPU/platform runtime and actual total parameter/embedding-table budgets for every candidate; broader token vocabularies are not language knowledge and consume V*d parameters in an ordinary table.

Include custom 10M/100M dense/static retrieval training or distillation as explicit candidates; compare against pretrained baselines before claiming training from scratch is easy or necessary. Report data, compute, training and inference costs.

Evaluate Q-only, A-only, Q+A and predeclared fusion using the same historical tasks. Generate assistant text before retrieval; exclude leaked task IDs/answers, and include incorrect or scope-expanding replies. User intent remains authoritative.

Use fair factorial baselines: Markdown with rg/BM25 without DIP/neural model; Markdown with the same neural retriever; structured DIP lexical only; structured DIP with neural/hybrid retrieval. Scale to 100/1000/10000 historical items with superseded/cancelled/open/completed tasks and version/scope confounders.

Measure Recall@1/5/10, MRR, false exact merges, stale/cancelled-rule errors, no-match abstention, downstream correctness, tokens, cold/warm CPU latency, RAM and indexing updates. Similarity/reranking scores are not completion evidence.
Split reviewed training/calibration/test examples by project, time and task family; do not mix paraphrase variants or use the already-published Laya pilot as both tuning and final-test data.
Keep alternatives and custom training unfinished until actually evaluated; retain all outcomes and use real code evidence for task completion.
